spans.s: ऋश्य—केतन and ऋश्य—केतु, m. N. of A-niruddha, L.
ऋश्य—केतन and ऋश्य—केतु, m. N. of A-niruddha, L.
ऋश्य—गन्धा f. a species of plant, Car.
ऋश्य—जिह्व n. a kind of leprosy, Car.; Suśr.
ऋश्य—द॑ n. a pit (for catching antelopes, BRD.; as hurting what falls into it, T.)
ऋश्य—प्रोक्ता f. N. of several plants.
ऋश्य—मूक m. N. of a mountain, VP.; R.; Pañcat. &c.
ऋश्य—लोभ m. N. of a man.
ऋश्य—शृङ्ग m. N. of several men.
N. of a gaṇa, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.
ifc. having the colour of or looking like the white-footed antelope, R.
